title: T1499.004 — Endpoint Denial of Service - Application or System Exploitation
subtitle: Watch a crafted packet crash a service, the watchdog restart it, the attacker repeat it, and the SOC (security operations center) connect the dots.
aria: T1499.004 - Endpoint Denial of Service - Application or System Exploitation

steps.title: Healthy service
steps.caption: The watchdog badge on the process box is green. Normal client requests arrive and are answered. The OS event log is quiet and the SOC panel shows no alerts
steps.defender: EDR and Sysmon record the process, memory and image-load events. Correlate them with the parent process.
